question:
An AC load draws $I=10\,\text{A}$ (rms) from a $230\,\text{V}$ (rms) single-phase supply and consumes real power $P=1.38\,\text{kW}$.

A student claims: “All $10\,\text{A}$ contributes to heating because current is $10\,\text{A}$.”

Evaluate this claim by identifying the **in-phase (wattful)** current component $I_w$, the **quadrature (wattless)** current component $I_q$, and the reactive power $Q$ of the load.
